Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left, with a reported impact to the wrist.
Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this
provider. The causal link between this incident and the fracture is not yet clear and is still under review. Five visits were
completed. Tretament followed a usual course, including immobilization, pain management, and follow-up imaging, and tapered
off as the patient improved. Function has returned to near baseline, with residual stiffness expected to resolve with routine home
exercises. Two simliar billing charges from the same day are currently being verified by the office. Ongoing monitoring is
recommended, and the patient will be seen again if symptoms worsen or fail to improve as expected.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
